verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron, laying out the rules: 📣
‘Tell Israel: If a man has a bodily discharge, that flow makes him ritually unclean. 🩺
Whether the flow keeps going or has stopped, the ritual uncleanness still applies. 📜
‘Any bed he lies on and anything he sits on is ritually unclean too. 🛏️
Anyone who touches that bed must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🧼
If you sit where he sat, wash your clothes, bathe in water, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🪑
Anyone who touches him must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🚿
‘If the man with the discharge spits on someone who’s clean, that person must wash their clothes, bathe, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 💧
‘Whatever saddle he rides on is ritually unclean. 🐎
Anyone touching something that was under him is ritually unclean till evening. If you carry those things, wash your clothes, bathe, and stay unclean till evening. 🧼
‘If he touches you before rinsing his hands with water, wash your clothes, bathe, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 💧
‘A clay pot he touches has to be broken; rinse any wooden bowl or vessel he touches with water. 🏺
‘Once the discharge clears, he must count out seven days, wash his clothes, and bathe in fresh running water. Then he’s ritually clean. 🌊
‘On day eight, he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, at the Meeting Tent entrance before Yahweh. 🕊️
The priest must offer one bird for the sin offering and the other for the burnt offering, making atonement for the man before Yahweh because of the discharge. 🙏
‘If a man has a semen emission, he must bathe his whole body in water and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🚿
Any clothes or leather with semen on it must be washed with water and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🧼
If a man and woman sleep together and he has a semen emission, both must bathe in water and stay ritually unclean till evening. 💧
‘When a woman has her monthly blood flow, she is ritually unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her is unclean till evening. 🌿
‘Anything she lies on or sits on during those days is ritually unclean too. 🛏️
If you touch her bed, wash your clothes, bathe in water, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🧼
If you touch anything she sat on, wash your clothes, bathe, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🚿
Touch something on her bed or a seat she used? You’re ritually unclean till evening. ⚠️
‘If a man sleeps with her while her monthly flow is happening, he is ritually unclean for seven days, and every bed he lies on is unclean. 📆
‘If a woman’s blood flow carries on for many days outside her period, or runs past when her period should end, she is unclean the whole time, just as during her period. 🩺
Every bed she lies on and anything she sits on during that flow is unclean, same as during her period. 🛏️
Anyone touching these things becomes unclean: wash your clothes, bathe in water, and stay ritually unclean till evening. 🧼
‘When her flow clears, she must count out seven days. After that, she’s ritually clean. 📆
On day eight, she must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the Meeting Tent entrance. 🕊️
The priest must offer one bird for the sin offering and one for the burnt offering, making atonement for her before Yahweh because of the uncleanness from her flow. 🙏
‘Keep Israel separated from this uncleanness, so they don’t die by defiling my Tabernacle among them.’ ⚠️
That’s the rulebook for a man with a discharge or semen emission that makes him ritually unclean, 📜
for a woman on her period, for anyone with a bodily discharge, and for a man who sleeps with a woman who is unclean.’ ⚖️
